sections.Profile:
"Road Kings," released by Williams in 1986, features a post-apocalyptic motorcycle gang theme designed by Mark Ritchie. The game includes two flippers, two ramps, and two-ball multiball play. It is part of the Williams System 11 series and integrates striking artwork by Tim Elliot and sound and music by Bill Parod and Chris Granner.
